Workflow

The 6-Stage Application Process

UKRI-aligned transparent evaluation protocol from submission to award.

01

Check Eligibility

Review call guidelines, eligible scientific domains, timeline, and applicant requirements.

02

Prepare Documents

Draft project summary, methodology, itemized budget form, and university endorsement letter.

03

Submit Application

Upload all proposal dossiers via the secure ClientFlow application portal before the call deadline.

04

Double-Blind Peer Review

Independent scientific and technical committees evaluate feasibility, novelty, and societal impact.

05

Decision Notification

Applicants receive transparent review scores and comprehensive feedback dossiers.

06

Award & Implementation

Execution of grant agreement, disbursement of funds or compute credits, and milestone tracking.

Guidance

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about eligibility, review, and funding disbursements.

1. Can undergraduate and graduate students apply?

Yes! UKABCS provides dedicated funding streams specifically for students through our Graduation Project Capacity Building Grants and Student Travel Assistance awards.

2. Is international collaboration allowed?

Absolutely. UKABCS actively encourages cross-border consortia. Projects demonstrating international partnerships between researchers in the UK and institutions across developing nations receive positive evaluation weighting.

3. Is an official support letter from the university required?

Yes, an institutional letter of endorsement from your department head, dean, or university research office is required.

4. Do you cover overhead or indirect costs?

UKABCS is a non-profit academic society focused on direct scientific impact. 100% of awarded funds directly support compute hours, reagents, software, student stipends, or open-access publication fees.
